create_crystal_object: create a Crystal object from a dict with frac_coords, atom_types, lengths, and angles
build_crystal_structure: build a pymatgen Structure from lattice parameters and fractional coordinates using Crystal.get_structure
test_smact_validity: test chemical composition validity using smact_validity with element symbols and stoichiometric counts
test_structure_validity: test crystal structure validity by checking inter-atomic distance matrix and volume cutoff
get_crystal_fingerprints: get magpie composition and CrystalNN structural fingerprints for a valid crystal using get_fingerprints
